sloka: न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं निहते वाहिनीपतौ ।सेतुबन्धं समासाद्य विकीर्णं सलिलं यथा ।। ६.५८.५८ ।।।।
transliteration: na śekuḥ samare sthātuṁ nihate vāhinīpatau ।setubandhaṁ samāsādya vikīrṇaṁ salilaṁ yathā ।। 6.58.58 ।।।।

translations.english: Prahastha having been killed by Neela, the cheerless Rakshasas and unshakeable troops could not stay there any more.
